prompts.music.theme.detailed: I want to write a song about [subject]. Mood: [mood]. Suggest 8 angles: for each, the central image, whose voice it's sung in, what changes from start to finish, and one original line idea for the chorus (not from well-known songs).
prompts.music.theme.refine: I like theme [number]. Give me 5 concrete details or images for the verses.
prompts.music.theme.check: My theme: [theme]. Is it too general? How can I make it more specific?
prompts.music.mood.short: What tempo and mood suit [scene or song]?
prompts.music.mood.detailed: For [scene or song], suggest 3 mood options. Table: description, approximate tempo (BPM), major or minor, rhythmic feel, dynamics (quiet, building, loud), which instruments help. Don't reference specific artists.
prompts.music.mood.refine: Make a transition from mood [number] to mood [number] within one piece.
prompts.music.mood.check: I've chosen [description]. Does it fit these lyrics: [lyrics]?
prompts.music.structure.short: Suggest a song structure for [minutes] minutes.
prompts.music.structure.detailed: Suggest 2 structures for a [genre] piece of about [minutes] minutes. For each section (intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge, outro): length in bars or seconds, what happens to the energy, what changes from the previous section.
prompts.music.structure.refine: Make a structure without a traditional chorus.
prompts.music.structure.check: Here's my structure: [structure]. Where might a listener get bored?
prompts.music.instruments.detailed: Choose an instrument palette: genre [genre], mood “[mood]”. Split by role: rhythm, bass, harmony, melody, texture. For each role, 2 instrument options and how they feel different. Add 1 unexpected instrument that could enrich the sound.
prompts.music.instruments.refine: I'd like to add a Kazakh traditional instrument. Which one and in what role?
prompts.music.instruments.check: Will [instruments] clash with each other in frequency range?
prompts.music.sound.short: Suggest sound design for [scene or video].
prompts.music.sound.detailed: I need sound design for [scene or video]: [description]. Suggest: background ambience, 5–7 spot effects with timing, where silence is needed, how music interacts with the effects. Mark which sounds I could record myself using household objects.
prompts.music.sound.refine: There are too many sounds. What should stay so they don't distract from speech?
prompts.music.sound.check: How can I check the sound design doesn't drown out the voice?
prompts.music.describe.short: Help me describe a piece of music in words: [what I hear]
prompts.music.describe.detailed: I'm listening to a piece and hear: [what I hear]. Help me describe it more professionally: tempo, rhythm, harmony, timbres, dynamics, form, mood. Suggest terms that fit my observations and explain them simply. Don't add things I haven't described.
prompts.music.describe.refine: What else should I listen for next time?
prompts.music.describe.check: Here's my description: [description]. Am I using the terms correctly?
prompts.music.melody.short: How can I develop a melody that starts like this: [description]?
prompts.music.melody.detailed: I have the start of a melody: [description: notes, up or down movement, rhythm]. Suggest 5 ways to develop it, in words: repetition with variation, contrary motion, a rhythm change, a climax, an answering phrase. For each, how it will feel. Don't copy known melodies.
prompts.music.melody.refine: The melody is too repetitive. Where can I add a surprising turn?
prompts.music.melody.check: How can I check my melody isn't too close to a well-known song?
prompts.music.title.short: Suggest 10 titles for a piece: [what it's about]
prompts.music.title.detailed: The piece: [what it's about], mood “[mood]”, key image [image]. Suggest 12 titles: single words, a phrase from possible lyrics, figurative, unexpected. For each, the impression it gives.
prompts.music.title.refine: Make the titles in [language], keeping the imagery.
prompts.music.title.check: Does the title “[title]” fit the mood of the music?
prompts.music.scene.detailed: Scene: [scene], length [seconds] seconds. Describe music for it: mood at the start and end, tempo, instruments, where it builds, where it goes silent, how it underlines the key moment. Give a short text description (up to 200 characters) usable in a music generator, without artist names.
prompts.music.scene.refine: Make a version where the music contrasts with the scene instead of mirroring it.
prompts.music.scene.check: Would this music distract from the dialogue in the scene?
prompts.music.avoid.short: Which stylistic clichés should I avoid in [genre]?
prompts.music.avoid.detailed: I'm writing a [genre] piece and want it to sound fresh. List 8 common clichés of the genre (in harmony, rhythm, lyrics, sound) and suggest an alternative for each. Don't reference specific artists or songs.
prompts.music.avoid.refine: Which of these clichés are worth keeping so listeners still recognise the genre?
prompts.music.avoid.check: Here's a description of my piece: [description]. Where does it sound too predictable?

verify.music.theme: A theme is just a starting point. Pick one that means something to you: a song without personal connection shows.
verify.music.mood: Check tempo and key by ear: the numbers are a guide, not a rule.
verify.music.structure: A structure is a frame. If the song needs something else, break it with confidence.
verify.music.instruments: Choosing instruments is a matter of taste. Listen to examples of each before deciding.
verify.music.sound: Take sound effects from libraries with a clear licence or record them yourself.
verify.music.describe: The AI can't hear the music if you've only described it. Compare the analysis with what you actually hear.
verify.music.melody: Test the melody on an instrument or with your voice: a verbal description doesn't replace sound.
verify.music.title: Search to check there isn't a well-known song with the same title.
verify.music.scene: If the music is AI-generated, read the service's terms on where and how it can be used.
verify.music.avoid: Imitating a specific artist may infringe rights and break service rules. Describe style through characteristics, not names.
